# Contributing

Bug fixes, security patches, and other critical improvements are welcome. Larger changes and feature enhancements will be reviewed individually to ensure they fit the project’s direction.

## Overview

This is my personal site. Useful contributions fix something that is broken: a layout problem in a particular browser, an accessibility issue, a bug in the game or the demo player, or a typo.

## Before you start

1. Read [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for local setup and project layout.
2. Keep the change focused on one problem when practical.
3. Run the site locally with `npx serve` and check the pages you touched in a desktop and a phone-sized window, in light and dark themes.
4. Do not commit secrets or local runtime data.

## Pull requests

### Summary
What changed, and why.

### Testing notes
Commands run and manual checks, including which browsers you tried.

### Acceptance criteria
Checkable outcomes. Screenshots or short recordings welcome for user-facing UI.

### What went wrong
Only if something is incomplete, flaky, or blocked. Errors, repro steps, and remaining work.

## Scope

The site stays plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no build step and no dependencies. The copy, the project list, and the visual design are mine to decide, so changes to those are unlikely to be merged.

## Reviews

I’m also a student with limited free time, so reviews may take a while. Thanks for bearing with me.
